description: Generate base 3D models with Tripo3D and finish them in Blender

plugins.name: tripo3d-blender
plugins.description: Set up Tripo3D from an API key, generate base meshes from text or pictures for the fewest credits, and make every refinement in Blender: size, facing, cleanup, repairs, repainting, levels of detail and GLB export.
